source_crosschecks.finding: zulassen records admission-like classifications and one session-level effect_id, but the normal PreToolUse dispatcher deliberately emits no deny/block decision; PostToolUse separately observes and journals outcome.
evaluate_head resolves dependencies from the central DAG; unknown, COMPUTE_OFF and taint-blocked heads return NOT_COMPUTED/value=None before compute_fn is called.

Realtime function calls remain queued until response.done; non-completed responses and barge-in clear pending calls before local dispatch, preventing interrupted-turn candidate effects from executing afterward.

architecture_findings.finding: Perception Control provides a reusable causal disablement pattern: NOT_COMPUTED is distinct from false/zero, dependency taint propagates, and COMPUTE_OFF prevents the underlying computation rather than merely hiding its output.

The archived Phase-43 ablation reports object.known.cup COMPUTE_OFF yielding NOT_COMPUTED while person.presence remained OK on the same frame. This supports the component pattern only; no new runtime execution occurred in this ingest.

Realtime barge-in/non-completed-response handling implements a useful pre-dispatch cancellation primitive for pending model-generated tool calls. It is not a canonical EffectGate and does not resolve UNKNOWN outcomes once an external effect may already have been submitted.

VoiceSessionCapsule remains an ephemeral compiled projection over multiple live sources. Cross-source temporal consistency is not established by an atomic snapshot, so Frankenstein 2.0 should bind context compilation to explicit generation/freshness/provenance rather than turn the capsule into a second state authority.

world_substrate: Map COMPUTE_OFF and dependency-taint semantics into WorldNeed/WorldSlice so protected variables stay NOT_COMPUTED through downstream transform chains.
Do not let vector similarity, reverse decomposition or another operator silently reconstruct a disabled protected variable.
Expose stop reason, blocked dependency and provenance in the read-only Cognitive Twin.
effects: Preserve EffectRequest, EffectDecision, EffectOutcome and ReentryStatus as distinct typed states.
Add PendingEffect {candidate_id,parent_response_id,state=PENDING|CANCELLED|SUBMITTED} before deterministic EffectGate submission.

Cancellation of a superseded/interrupted cognitive turn may invalidate PENDING candidates; SUBMITTED external effects transition only through observed SUCCEEDED|FAILED|UNKNOWN and are never blindly replayed.
Actual DENY authority must remain at the executor/host boundary capable of preventing execution.
voice_context: Compile a bounded per-response GRID/Voice context slice with generation, freshness, provenance and privacy tier.
Keep VoiceSessionCapsule RAM-only/noncanonical; do not create an autonomous voice-memory truth store.
Require field-level lesion/shuffle tests before claiming causal conditioning.

preserved_contradictions.note: Normal stern.py effect admission bookkeeping is nonblocking; separate actual host/blocker authority remains to be mapped.
Strong policy enforcement does not imply strong detector/model quality or prove every live caller routes through evaluate_head.
Realtime pending-call cancellation is pre-dispatch control only and must not be promoted to whole-system EffectGate authority.

required_triggerword4_acceptance_tests: COMPUTE_OFF protected world variable remains NOT_COMPUTED through dependent WorldSlice operators and cannot be reconstructed by a downstream dependency.
Unknown/unregistered protected dependency fails closed as NOT_COMPUTED rather than false/zero.
Cancelled or barge-in parent response with a PENDING tool candidate produces zero local tool dispatches.
A tool candidate already marked SUBMITTED is not silently converted to CANCELLED; outcome remains SUCCEEDED, FAILED or UNKNOWN from evidence.
Parallel/reordered tool calls preserve per-call request/decision/outcome identity with zero cross-assignment.
Voice context compiler rejects stale/mismatched generation and preserves UNKNOWN rather than filling missing presence/state fields.
Lesion/shuffle of a declared Voice/GRID conditioning field changes only preregistered decisions and yields a bounded conditioning receipt.
next_exact_gate: Map the separately referenced blocking wache-koenig predecessor/current host permission path and prove which component can actually stop execution.
Audit all live perception callers for evaluate_head bypasses before granting system-wide privacy/NOT_COMPUTED credit.
Finish Realtime silence-reopen/stale-context revalidation and bind VoiceSessionCapsule successor to one generation-stamped GRID context compiler.
Feed pending-effect cancellation plus taint-preserving WorldSlice invariants into Triggerword-4 tests without executing the donor.
